O Superman, Laurie Anderson
pinboard.description:
"O Superman [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Vkfpi2H8tOE ] by artist Laurie Anderson from 1981. Some of the lyrics:
‘Cause when love is gone There’s always justice And when justice is gone There’s always force And when force is gone There’s always Mom Hi, Mom So hold me, Mom In your long arms So hold me, Mom In your long arms In your automatic arms Your electronic arms In your arms So hold me, Mom In your long arms Your petrochemical arms Your military arms In your electronic arms Ah, ah, ah, ah
60 Minutes did a profile of Anderson [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rydadItdnt0 ] a few years ago and she explained the meaning of the song (to her):
This is a song about how basically technology cannot save you. It’s about a lot of things: justice, safety, power.
As a kid growing up in rural Wisconsin, this kind of music wasn’t available to me, so I only actually heard this for the first time fairly recently. So I thought I’d post it in case you hadn’t really heard it either — that and the message & meaning it carries is relevant these days. I also liked this rendition of it, slowed down and reverbed [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=weKDWJQpi1U ]. There are also several O Superman remixes on Soundcloud [https://soundcloud.com/search/sounds?q=o%20superman%20remix ] of varying quality. "

InsForge/instacloud-oss: 一个可自托管的替代方案，可替代 Railway、Render、Fly 和 AWS。只需一个运行在 Docker 容器上的守护进程，即可为每个应用程序提供托管的 Postgres 和 S3 存储桶、git 推送部署、可 f
pinboard.description:
开源、可自托管的 PaaS：在单个服务器上构建您自己的无服务器云。
特征
分支是磁盘的分叉。reflink insta branch create会复制 Postgres 数据目录和每个计算卷，复制存储桶，并将应用程序重新部署到各自的 URL 上。在支持 reflink 的文件系统上，休眠数据库大约只需一秒即可完成分叉；而对于处于唤醒状态或不支持 reflink 的数据源，则会pg_basebackup根据其大小进行流式传输和扩展。
单机无服务器架构。服务可缩减至零，并在约两秒内响应第一个请求；main默认保持始终在线，其他分支可选择启用。
与云端相同的命令和 API 接口。一个守护进程负责响应托管平台的 API，因此，insta自托管环境下的 CLI、代理技能和控制面板的工作方式与云端相同。仅限云端的操作（计费、扩展、域名购买）则501通过引导式响应来响应。
一个项目由 Postgres、S3 和你的容器组成。守护进程会配置数据库、对象存储桶和你的应用程序容器，并将它们凭据集成到你的环境中。
Git 推送部署。将计算服务绑定到 GitHub 代码库，每次推送到跟踪分支时，都会使用 BuildKit（通过 HMAC 验证的 webhook）构建推送的提交，并在现有端口上重新部署（用法见下文）。仅限自托管：云端的 GitHub-App Connect 需要多租户应用程序，因此它保持不变501。
专为编码代理而设计。每个分支都有沙箱，对敏感操作设有选择加入的审批门，并提供完整的审计跟踪（insta agent events）：代理在其自己的分支上部署和验证，而您保留否决权。
单命令模板。使用以下命令从捆绑目录部署应用程序insta template deploy <code>，该应用程序将从此服务器运行，无需访问互联网。

pinboard.description:
Saudi-announced campaign against the Houthis is going great I see =|
The frontline in Yemen remains focused around the key city of Taiz, which is still controlled by the internationally recognised government. On Sunday, the Houthis cut a vital supply route linking Taiz with Aden, the interim capital of the Yemeni government, AFP news agency reports. Citing three Yemeni military sources, AFP also reports that the Houthis now control the area and supply route, effectively encircling Taiz. "They've achieved the military objective of isolating Taiz from Aden, even if they haven't fully taken control of it," Farea Al-Muslimi, a research fellow at the Chatham House think tank, told AFP.
